SUMMARY.md:
> A deterministic calculator for US income tax: federal brackets and FICA, all 50 states
> and the District of Columbia, and local income tax where counties, cities or school
> districts levy one.
>
> No key, no signup, no request body required, a GET with an income and a state code is
> enough. CORS is open, so it can be called from a browser.
>
> Every response carries the document each figure was read from and the date it was
> checked, under `sources`. Nothing is estimated or interpolated: a figure either comes
> from a primary source or the endpoint does not return it.
